claim: maup is maintained by MGGG (Metric Geometry and Gerrymandering Group), now branded the Data and Democracy Lab, and was first announced in June 2019 as a Python package to streamline redistricting-data workflows (assigning, aggregating, disaggregating, prorating spatial data).
stance_target: provenance and maturity of the maup crosswalk toolkit
quoted_support: maup is our attempt to make working with redistricting data easier for everyone. It is a Python package that streamlines the basic workflows that arise when working with blocks, precincts, and districts
